instrumentation_note: Case-local ASM probe records exact bytecode guard/throw, direct connection/epoch I/O, and production line coverage. Historical 25 attempts used a legacy GraphChecker JAR solely for JUnit lifecycle; 5-8 fault continuations used an independent JUnit Platform runner and a classpath without GraphChecker/skeleton. No graph/static/aggregate/closure output controlled execution.
elapsed_measurement: sum of all completed case-local JVM runs including probe preflight, healthy seed, positive control and fault trials; excludes manual source review/build time and idle gaps
coverage_gain_qualification: coverage_gain is observed new line coverage against the healthy seed; admitted_coverage_gain requires exact applied faults and target evaluation after the final fault
quality_limit: The ninth-fault write-ordinal-10 path, uninstrumented I/O, and other schedules were not tested. Earlier 25 attempts used a legacy GraphChecker JAR solely for JUnit lifecycle; new 5-8 fault attempts did not load it.
budget_extension: Historical 25-attempt checkpoint plus four new 5-8 fault sequences; none of the historical trials were replayed.
stopping_reason: Across the healthy seed and 29 completed fault attempts, 20 observed direct I/O (site, global ordinal) occurrences precede a later target guard. Nineteen were exactly faulted. The sole remainder, client TCP write ordinal 10, appears before a later target only after eight applied faults; selecting it would require a ninth fault beyond max8. Four new 5-8 fault sequences all matched fully, passed the original JUnit, retained the exact target after the last fault, and added no production line coverage or selected target throw. No untried observed selector remains feasible within the eight-fault budget.
new_budget_incomplete_setup: An initial 5-fault pure-JUnit run passed its test but the runner did not exit; it was terminated and excluded from the completed-trial ledger before rerunning with corrected runner.
